page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, full width. No margin notes. Page number 493 at the head. Catchword "Er-" at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.l: hoc ne est ex principiis veris conclusionem
elicere? Quidquid sit de sequentibus capi-
fiducia propriæ iustitiæ, ac operum meritis,
ciis, non cum Reformatis convenire re-
defendit. Non effugit autem censuram Allatij,

l.i: eo quod reliqua præter Baptismum, & sacram

main_text.l: sus hic ad convellendum consensum non
adeo iuvat oppositorem. Sed hoc est non veterum,

l.i: nes quidam Damascenus vir octavi[?] seculi, cum
Christianam omnem Theologiam, eo opere, quod
de Orthodoxa fide scripsit, complexus sit, illam
norum aliqua fortasse æmulatio eos ad hunc se-
re illis inferiores esse viderentur, deduxit. Sunt
verba Dallæi. Ergo Græci etiam recentio-
res, ut Latinis non sint inferiores in aliquo.

page.notes: Greek phrase after "illam" is not legible enough to transcribe; replaced by a placeholder. "octavi" is doubtful: the ligature could be read differently. Italic boundaries in the second paragraph are approximate. Spacing after "admetitur," is as printed (no space). "aliquare" is printed as a run-on across "aliqua" and "re"; kept as the line shows it with the hyphen-free join, but check against the scan. Long s normalised to s; i/j and u/v normalised; the printed form "principijs" was changed to "principiis" and "Pontificijs" to "Pontificiis".
